cues.en: Instructor: In this video, I'm going to introduce you to the Wilcoxon signed-rank test.
cues.zh: 講師：這部影片介紹 Wilcoxon 符號等級檢定。

cues.en: Now, you don't see the letter T anywhere in this name.
cues.zh: 名稱裡看不到字母 t。

cues.en: However, this is a t-test.
cues.zh: 但這是 t 檢定。

cues.en: This is a variant of the t-test.
cues.zh: 是 t 檢定的一種變形。

cues.en: In particular, the Wilcoxon signed rank test is a non-parametric t-test.
cues.zh: 具體說，是無母數 t 檢定。

cues.en: Now, this is a slide that I showed several videos ago in the one-sample t-test.
cues.zh: 這張投影片，是幾部前單一樣本 t 檢定展示過的。

cues.en: This was about the assumptions for the one sample t-test.
cues.zh: 介紹其假設。

cues.en: I would like to draw your attention to this key assumption here, which is that the mean and standard deviation are valid descriptors of the central tendency and dispersion.
cues.zh: 請注意這個關鍵假設：平均值和標準差，能有效描述集中趨勢與離散程度。

cues.en: That's another way of saying that the data are approximately normally distributed, roughly Gaussian-distributed, with some reasonable tolerance level.
cues.zh: 換句話說，在合理容許範圍內，資料大致呈常態、高斯分布。

cues.en: Now, if your data do not meet this assumption, if your data are non-normally distributed, then you can use the Wilcoxon signed-rank test
cues.zh: 如果不符合，資料不是常態分布，就可以使用 Wilcoxon 符號等級檢定，

cues.en: as a non-parametric alternative to the one-sample t-test or to the two-sample paired t-test.
cues.zh: 作為單一樣本 t 檢定，或成對雙樣本 t 檢定的無母數替代。

cues.en: So the signed rank test is the non-parametric alternative to these two t-tests, actually, the one-sample t-test and the two-samples t-test,
cues.zh: 它其實是這兩種 t 檢定的替代：單一樣本，以及雙樣本，

cues.en: but only for the two-samples paired t-test.
cues.zh: 但雙樣本只限成對。

cues.en: I'll talk about that on the next slide.
cues.zh: 下一張會談。

cues.en: It is used when the data do not conform to the normality assumption, and the reason is that the Wilcoxon signed-rank test is converting all the data differences into ranks.
cues.zh: 資料不符合常態性假設時使用，原因是它會將所有資料差值轉成秩。

cues.en: So we are testing data ranks instead of data means.
cues.zh: 所以檢驗的是資料秩，而非平均值。

cues.en: So that's very similar to testing medians.
cues.zh: 和檢驗中位數很類似。

cues.en: Okay, so here I'm going to give you a list of different non-parametric t-tests that are associated with their parametric counterparts.
cues.zh: 這裡列出不同無母數 t 檢定，以及對應的母數方法。

cues.en: So it looks a little bit confusing, because unfortunately, there are several different names for exactly the same test.
cues.zh: 有點混淆，因為可惜完全相同的檢定，有好幾個名稱。

cues.en: So the Wilcoxon signed-rank test, also called the signed-rank test, leaving out the Wilcoxon.
cues.zh: Wilcoxon signed-rank test，也可省略 Wilcoxon，叫符號等級檢定。

cues.en: This is what you would use as a non-parametric alternative to two situations: either a one-sample t-test or a two-samples t-test,
cues.zh: 可作為兩種情況的無母數替代：單一樣本，或雙樣本 t 檢定，

cues.en: but only the two-samples t-test when the samples are paired, or also called dependent.
cues.zh: 但雙樣本只限成對，也稱相依樣本。

cues.en: And then we have these other names.
cues.zh: 再來有其他名稱。

cues.en: I'm gonna talk about this in a separate video in a few videos from now.
cues.zh: 再過幾部影片，會另用一部說明。

cues.en: So the main point to know here.
cues.zh: 目前主要要知道，

cues.en: These are all the same tests, unfortunately.
cues.zh: 可惜這些都是同個檢定，

cues.en: It's just given different names.
cues.zh: 只是名稱不同。

cues.en: So the main point to know for right now, for this video, is that the signed-rank test is for one sample, or it's for two samples, but only if those are paired samples.
cues.zh: 這部影片目前的重點，是符號等級檢定用於單一樣本，或兩個成對樣本。

cues.en: What I'm going to do now is walk you through the algorithm to compute the Wilcoxon test.
cues.zh: 接著逐步介紹計算 Wilcoxon 檢定的演算法。

cues.en: It gets a little bit hairy when we get down to step four.
cues.zh: 到了第四步會有點複雜。

cues.en: I don't actually recommend memorizing this algorithm.
cues.zh: 其實不建議背這個演算法。

cues.en: This is not something that I recommend putting on flashcards and going through over and over again because this is not something that you are going to have to program yourself.
cues.zh: 不建議寫在字卡上反覆複習，因為不需要自己編寫。

cues.en: However, I think it is useful to see the algorithm, to go through the algorithm at least once, so you understand the concept behind the signed rank test.
cues.zh: 但至少看過、走一遍，理解背後概念很有用。

cues.en: Okay, so that said, we start with step one.
cues.zh: 先從第一步開始。

cues.en: Step one is to remove equal pairs if you have a two-samples test, or for one sample-situation, you would remove any data points
cues.zh: 如果是雙樣本，移除相等的配對；如果單一樣本，移除所有

cues.en: that exactly equal the null hypothesis value.
cues.zh: 恰好等於虛無假設值的資料點。

cues.en: Now, one reasoning for this is that equal pairs do not contribute to the test either way, or data values that exactly equal the null hypothesis
cues.zh: 原因之一是，相等配對不對任何方向提供貢獻；恰好等於虛無假設的資料值，

cues.en: are not contributing to the test.
cues.zh: 也不對檢定提供貢獻。

cues.en: There's a numerical reason as well, which we'll get to in step three, which is basically that we need to count the number of data points that are greater than zero,
cues.zh: 還有數值上的理由，第三步會看到，基本上要計算大於 0 的資料點數，

cues.en: not equal to zero, but greater than zero.
cues.zh: 不是等於 0，而是大於 0。

cues.en: Okay, so anyway, this is step one, basically just preparing the data by possibly removing data points.
cues.zh: 第一步基本上是準備資料，可能移除一些點。

cues.en: So you might not actually be removing any data points here.
cues.zh: 也可能實際上一個都不必移除。

cues.en: Step two is to rank-transform the differences.
cues.zh: 第二步，對差值進行秩轉換。

cues.en: So we take x minus y.
cues.zh: 取 x−y。

cues.en: And again, if this is a two-samples test, you're subtracting the values, these paired values, and if this is a one-sample test, then Y gets replaced with the null hypothesis value.
cues.zh: 如果雙樣本，減去成對數值；單一樣本則以虛無假設值取代 y。

cues.en: I call that mu in the video on the one-sample t-test.
cues.zh: 單一樣本 t 檢定影片中稱為 μ。

cues.en: And now, we're actually taking the rank transform of the absolute value of these differences, so not the differences themselves, but just the magnitudes of these differences.
cues.zh: 實際上，取的是差值絕對值的秩，不是差值本身，而只是大小。

cues.en: And we're gonna call that variable r.
cues.zh: 把變數稱為 r。

cues.en: You still need to keep x minus y, because that's gonna be relevant for step three, but the point of step two is to come up with this variable r,
cues.zh: 仍要保留 x−y，第三步會用，但第二步是取得 r，

cues.en: that is, for each data point, or each pair of data points for a two-samples test, it's the rank of the absolute value of the difference between x and y.
cues.zh: 也就是每個資料點，或雙樣本中的每對資料，x、y 差值絕對值的秩。

cues.en: Okay, so then we have this variable r.
cues.zh: 得到變數 r。

cues.en: And then we are going to compute another term called w.
cues.zh: 接著計算另一項，叫 w。

cues.en: And the the way we compute w is that we sum up all of the r values that we computed in step two.
cues.zh: 做法是加總第二步算出的 r 值。

cues.en: However, we don't actually sum up all of them.
cues.zh: 但其實不是全部相加。

cues.en: We sum up only the values of r where x is greater than y.
cues.zh: 只加 x>y 那些 r 值。

cues.en: And again, for one sample t-test, this would be we sum up all the values of r only for the individual data points that are greater than the null hypothesis value.
cues.zh: 對單一樣本，就是只加個別資料點大於虛無假設值的 r。

cues.en: Now, this is a little bit of an abuse of mathematical notation here, because this stuff is mathematical notation.
cues.zh: 這有一點濫用數學記號，因為這部分是數學記號，

cues.en: This is a bit of a computer science notation, where I would take this value, this quantity here,
cues.zh: 這部分則有點電腦科學記號，將這個量

cues.en: to be either zero or one, so like computing a Boolean, and then converting that Boolean into the number zero or the number one.
cues.zh: 視為 0 或 1，像計算布林值，再轉成數字 0、1。

cues.en: But essentially, all we're doing is summing the ranks only for the ranks where the data values were greater than y.
cues.zh: 基本上，只加資料值大於 y 的那些秩。

cues.en: Okay, so the goal of step three is to create this quantity w.
cues.zh: 第三步目標，就是建立 w。

cues.en: And then in step four, we plug w into this bizarre-looking equation.
cues.zh: 第四步，把 w 代入這個奇怪方程式。

cues.en: I dunno how Wilcoxon derived this with the number four here and the 24 here.
cues.zh: 不知道 Wilcoxon 怎麼推導出這裡的 4 和 24。

cues.en: But anyway.
cues.zh: 總之。

cues.en: So w goes into the numerator, and it's related to n, both in the numerator and in the denominator.
cues.zh: w 在分子，並且分子、分母都和 n 有關。

cues.en: Ultimately, that gives us this final quantity that we're interested in, which is z.
cues.zh: 最後得到關心的量 z。

cues.en: And then once we get this z, this z number here is normally distributed under the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 得到 z 後，在虛無假設下，它呈常態分布。

cues.en: And so we can convert this z into a p value, treating this like a normal standard deviation number.
cues.zh: 因此把它當作標準常態下的標準差數值，轉成 P 值。

cues.en: So we look up on a normal distribution, a Gaussian distribution, a probability density, and convert this said into a p value,
cues.zh: 查常態、高斯分布的機率密度，把這個 z 轉成 P 值，

cues.en: and that gives us the p value of our Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
cues.zh: 就得到 Wilcoxon 等級和檢定的 P 值。

cues.en: So now, in this video, you have learned about the Wilcoxon signed-rank test, also sometimes just called the signed-rank test.
cues.zh: 這部影片學到 Wilcoxon 符號等級檢定，有時簡稱符號等級檢定。

cues.en: Again, it is designed for two situations.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，設計用於兩種情況。

cues.en: It is an alternative to the one sample t-test when your data are non-normally distributed, and it's an alternative to the two-samples paired t-test
cues.zh: 資料非常態時，是單一樣本 t 檢定的替代，也是成對雙樣本 t 檢定的替代，

cues.en: when your data are non-normally distributed.
cues.zh: 同樣是在資料不呈常態時。
